description: iOS (WP5): the bundled app in the main window may call the shell's sign-in/token/server/link commands, export_note and save_export (a note / an export archive → the system share sheet) and the six iOS commands (server reset, app lock, APNs), and nothing else: no core:* plugin APIs, no opener, no fs, no shell, no prism-ios plugin commands (the Swift plugin is reached only from Rust), and no quick capture or desktop notifications. Remote origins get no IPC at all (no `remote` block).
